+"""Regressions for explicit None annotations and runtime-only metadata."""
+
+import ast
+import inspect
+import sys
+import types
+import typing
+
+import pytest
+
+from metaflow.cmd.develop import stub_generator
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def generator(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(stub_generator, "get_version", lambda: "test")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("METAFLOW_STUBGEN", "1")
+    module = types.ModuleType("metaflow.continuation_example")
+    module.__file__ = str(tmp_path / "continuation_example.py")
+    module.typing = typing
+    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, module.__name__, module)
+    result = stub_generator.StubGenerator(str(tmp_path / "stubs"))
+    result._current_module = result._current_parent_module = module
+    result._current_module_name = module.__name__
+    return result
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("postponed", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("explicit_signature", [False, True])
+def test_none_parameters_keep_kinds_defaults_and_missing_annotations(
+    generator, postponed, explicit_signature
+):
+    source = """
+def function(pos: None, /, regular: None = None, *args: None,
+             keyword: None = None, missing=0, **kwargs: None) -> None:
+    pass
+"""
+    if postponed:
+        source = "from __future__ import annotations\n" + source
+    exec(source, generator._current_module.__dict__)
+    function = generator._current_module.function
+    arguments = (
+        {"sign": [inspect.signature(function)], "doc": ""}
+        if explicit_signature
+        else {"func": function}
+    )
+    text = generator._generate_function_stub("function", **arguments)
+    node = ast.parse(text).body[0]
+    annotated = (
+        node.args.posonlyargs
+        + node.args.args
+        + [node.args.vararg, node.args.kwonlyargs[0], node.args.kwarg]
+    )
+    assert all(isinstance(arg.annotation, ast.Constant) for arg in annotated)
+    assert all(arg.annotation.value is None for arg in annotated)
+    assert [arg.arg for arg in node.args.posonlyargs] == ["pos"]
+    assert [arg.arg for arg in node.args.args] == ["regular"]
+    assert [arg.arg for arg in node.args.kwonlyargs] == ["keyword", "missing"]
+    assert node.args.kwonlyargs[1].annotation is None
+    assert ast.literal_eval(node.args.defaults[0]) is None
+    assert [ast.literal_eval(value) for value in node.args.kw_defaults] == [None, 0]
+    assert isinstance(node.returns, ast.Constant) and node.returns.value is None
+    for prefix in (": ", " -> ", ""):
+        assert generator._exploit_annotation(None, prefix) == ""
+        assert generator._exploit_annotation(inspect.Parameter.empty, prefix) == ""
+
+
+def test_none_overload_keeps_decorators_and_other_signature(generator):
+    exec("""
+@typing.overload
+def convert(value: None = None) -> None: ...
+@typing.overload
+def convert(value: str) -> str: ...
+def convert(value=None): pass
+""", generator._current_module.__dict__)
+    text = generator._generate_function_stub(
+        "convert", staticmethod(generator._current_module.convert)
+    )
+    first, second = ast.parse(text).body
+    assert isinstance(first.args.args[0].annotation, ast.Constant)
+    assert first.args.args[0].annotation.value is None
+    assert ast.literal_eval(first.args.defaults[0]) is None
+    assert isinstance(first.returns, ast.Constant) and first.returns.value is None
+    assert ast.unparse(second.args.args[0].annotation) == "str"
+    assert ast.unparse(second.returns) == "str"
+    assert not second.args.defaults
+    assert all(
+        [ast.unparse(decorator) for decorator in node.decorator_list]
+        == ["typing.overload", "staticmethod"]
+        for node in (first, second)
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("annotated_accessors", [False, True])
+def test_none_property_preserves_accessors_and_field_fallback(
+    generator, annotated_accessors
+):
+    exec("""
+class Example:
+    value: None
+
+    @property
+    def value(self): pass
+
+    @value.setter
+    def value(self, value): pass
+""", generator._current_module.__dict__)
+    clazz = generator._current_module.Example
+    if annotated_accessors:
+        clazz.value.fget.__annotations__["return"] = None
+        clazz.value.fset.__annotations__.update(value=None, return_value=str)
+        clazz.value.fset.__annotations__["return"] = None
+    node = ast.parse(generator._generate_class_stub("Example", clazz)).body[0]
+    getter, setter = node.body
+    assert [ast.unparse(d) for d in getter.decorator_list] == ["property"]
+    assert [ast.unparse(d) for d in setter.decorator_list] == ["value.setter"]
+    assert isinstance(getter.returns, ast.Constant) and getter.returns.value is None
+    assert isinstance(setter.args.args[1].annotation, ast.Constant)
+    assert setter.args.args[1].annotation.value is None
+
+
+class InvalidRepr:
+    def __repr__(self):
+        return "<runtime-only metadata>"
+
+
+class RaisingRepr:
+    def __repr__(self):
+        raise RuntimeError("cannot represent metadata")
+
+
+class ExpressionRepr:
+    def __repr__(self):
+        return "record_effect()"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("opaque", [object(), InvalidRepr(), RaisingRepr(), ExpressionRepr()])
+def test_annotated_metadata_is_literal_or_placeholder(generator, opaque):
+    annotation = typing.Annotated[
+        list[int], "description", {"units": ["m", 1]}, None, opaque
+    ]
+    text = generator._exploit_annotation(annotation, "")
+    expression = ast.parse(text, mode="eval").body
+    assert ast.unparse(expression.slice.elts[0]) == "list[int]"
+    assert [ast.literal_eval(arg) for arg in expression.slice.elts[1:]] == [
+        "description", {"units": ["m", 1]}, None, Ellipsis
+    ]
+    assert "typing" in generator._imports
+    namespace = {"typing": typing}
+    exec("value: " + text, namespace)
+    assert typing.get_args(namespace["__annotations__"]["value"])[1:] == (
+        "description", {"units": ["m", 1]}, None, Ellipsis
+    )
+
+
+def test_write_out_preserves_none_and_valid_metadata(generator, tmp_path):
+    module = generator._current_module
+    module.metadata = object()
+    exec("""
+def function(value: None, *, data: typing.Annotated[int, metadata]) -> None: pass
+""", module.__dict__)
+    generator._pending_modules = [(module.__name__, module.__name__)]
+    generator.write_out()
+    text = (tmp_path / "stubs" / "continuation_example.pyi").read_text()
+    node = next(node for node in ast.parse(text).body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef))
+    assert isinstance(node.args.args[0].annotation, ast.Constant)
+    assert node.args.args[0].annotation.value is None
+    metadata = node.args.kwonlyargs[0].annotation.slice.elts[1]
+    assert ast.literal_eval(metadata) is Ellipsis
+    assert "import typing" in text
